title: BJP holds Loktantra Bachao rally in Gorakhpur

tea.why: The BJP is holding rallies to counter the INDIA bloc's protests against the Election Commission regarding alleged electoral irregularities.
tea.want: The party aims to defend the current electoral process and counter opposition claims of 'vote chori' and electoral manipulation.
tea.changed: Nov 4: BJP national president Nitin Nabin and UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath led the rally in Gorakhpur.

summary: On November 4, 2026, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) held a 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' (Save Democracy, Remove Anarchy) rally in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. The event was led by BJP national president Nitin Nabin and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, with participation from NDA alliance partners including the Nishad Party and the Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD). The rally was part of a broader nationwide campaign by the BJP to counter the INDIA bloc's recent protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. During the event, speakers criticized opposition leaders, specifically targeting Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav, and dismissed allegations of electoral irregularities as excuses for political defeat. The Congress party's Uttar Pradesh president, Aradhana Misra, criticized the BJP for staging protests against the opposition.
demands: Counter opposition claims of electoral irregularities
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: BJP national president Nitin Nabin and UP CM Yogi Adityanath led the rally in Gorakhpur to counter opposition protests.
